items.title: ‘I’m leaving money on the table’: I’m 64 and my husband is 70. Should I take spousal benefits or wait for my own?
items.description: “I paid a significant amount into Social Security.”

items.description: Fed watchers say the upcoming jobs report and inflation data are key after seeing signs that Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh would be willing to see interest rates rise.

items.title: ‘It’s not fair’: My twin brother and I were left houses by our parents. Can I make him pay his share for taxes and upkeep?

items.title: ‘I feel tricked’: My contractor handed my $42,000 pool upgrade to a subcontractor I had already rejected. What can I do?

items.title: Here’s how much Americans rely on Social Security — at all income levels

items.description: “Roth assets would provide our children with tax-free distributions.”

items.title: Medicare Advantage patients who get diagnosed with Alzheimer’s or other serious diseases are ditching their plans — and it can cost them
items.description: The annual Medicare open-enrollment period runs from Oct. 15 to Dec. 7.

items.title: My friend is charging everyone $80 to attend her 30th birthday party. She says it’s to cover the open bar. Is it rude to not go?
